title: Army public affairs source terrified of the NSA
summary: UAPGerb tells of Army public affairs source terrified of the NSA, about mid-2010s at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: this individual was in US Army Office of Public Affairs. He served in the mid2010s and he said I like I'm not really afraid of the CIA but what I'm terrified of is the NSA.

plain: A UFO researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb told podcast host Jesse Michels about a man he spoke with who worked in the US Army's public affairs office, the part of the Army that deals with the press and the public, in the mid-2010s. According to UAPGerb, this man said he was not really afraid of the CIA, the US spy agency, but was terrified of the NSA, the agency that intercepts and monitors communications. UAPGerb tells it as a hint that people near these secrets feel the eavesdroppers are the ones to fear most.
